text: And these are the inheritances which the children{H1121} of Israel{H3478} took{H5157} in the land{H776} of Canaan,{H3667} which Eleazar{H499} the priest,{H3548} and Joshua{H3091} the son{H1121} of Nun,{H5126} and the heads{H7218} of the fathers'{H1} [houses] of the tribes{H4294} of the children{H1121} of Israel,{H3478} distributed{H5157} unto them,
